name: code-on-demand
label: COD · optional
title: Code-on-demand (§5.1.7)
summary: Clients may be extended by code the server sends; optional, because it reduces visibility.
quote: “The final addition to our constraint set for REST comes from the code-on-demand style of Section 3.5.3 (Figure 5-8). REST allows client functionality to be extended by downloading and executing code in the form of applets or scripts. This simplifies clients by reducing the number of features required to be pre-implemented. Allowing features to be downloaded after deployment improves system extensibility. However, it also reduces visibility, and thus is only an optional constraint within REST.”
cite: Roy T. Fielding, Architectural Styles and the Design of Network-based Software Architectures, §5.1.7
